_doc: Keys are Terraria internal item names; ids, names and sprites come from the game files.

type: block | material | tool | melee | ranged | magic | thrown | ammo | consumable | accessory | armor | summon | coin | hook (a grappling hook, GrappleHook: Terraria's AI_007_GrapplingHooks; projectile: its ProjectileID, sheet Projectile_N; speed (shootSpeed), retract and reach in px a tick / px; fly: hooks out at once less those latched (QuickGrapple), out: firing with that many out drops the oldest, latched: latching past that many drops the oldest; updates: moves that many times a tick (extraUpdates + 1); chain: its chain sprite) | tool_use (used for its effect: rope_snake, ocean_teleport, rope_coil: thrown (RopeCoil), it lays a line of `rope` blocks, what it couldn't lay dropping as `item`) | pet (pet: its pet, a ProjectileID name in Minion.KINDS; using it again sends it off; light_pet: a light pet, the other pet slot). summon with minion: a summon staff (its minion, Minion.KINDS; damage is summon damage). mount (mount: Player.MOUNTS, on and off). extractinator: true: use it on an Extractinator to sift it (Terraria's ExtractinatorMode 0: silt and slush)
plant_on: grass seeds: used on that block it becomes the seeds' block (Mushroom Grass Seeds on mud).

auto_reuse: held down, it's used again and again (Terraria's autoReuse); otherwise each use takes a fresh click. By default tools, buckets and blocks do and nothing else does, like Terraria's items here (doors and the Bed are blocks that don't).
use_time is in ticks (1/60 s) like Terraria; for tools it's Terraria's mining / tool speed (ticks between hits). shoot_speed is in blocks per second.
Tiers: pick / axe are Terraria's pickaxe and axe power (%), pick_speed / axe_speed their tool speeds.
armor equip: its name in Terraria's ArmorIDs where that differs from its item name (the Bee Mask: QueenBeeMask), for its equipped sprite.

armor: slot head | body | legs, defense, and bonuses (percent): damage, crit, melee_damage, melee_crit, melee_speed, ranged_damage, ranged_crit, magic_damage, magic_crit, mana_cost (reduction), ammo_save (chance), mining_speed, move_speed; mana_bonus (points); light [r,g,b]; fire_walk (Terraria's fireWalk: fire blocks like Hellstone don't burn you; the Obsidian Skull and its kin); fire_immune (can't be set On Fire!, by lava or anything: the Molten set). vanity: worn only for its look (Terraria's vanity items: no defense). wand_ammo (a tile wand: the Bone Wand): placing its block uses up one of that instead of the wand. own_look: drawn as your own hair or clothes, no sprite of its own (the Familiar Wig, Shirt and Pants: Terraria's slot 0). Accessories may carry the same keys. hair: the player's hair under a helmet ("hat": Terraria's hat hair, "full"), none by default.

armor_sets: the bonus for wearing all three pieces; text is the key of Terraria's set bonus text (ArmorSetBonus). crimson_regen: the Crimson set's (Terraria's crimsonRegen: natural healing builds up twice as fast and heals half again as much). Tiers add <Metal>Helmet / Chainmail / Greaves (armor: defense of each, set_defense, armor_bars).

rocket: rocket boots (Terraria's rocketBoots; 7 bursts of 10 ticks of flight). magic_cuffs: damage taken comes back as mana. mana_regen_bonus: Terraria's manaRegenBonus (half a mana a second each). regen: Terraria's lifeRegen (half a life a second each). block_range: tiles more reach placing blocks (the Toolbelt). info gps: a Gold Watch, a Depth Meter and a Compass. harpoon (ranged): Terraria's aiStyle 13 {speed, back: px a tick out and in, reach px, pierce, drop_after ticks, chain} (HarpoonShot). invasion (summon): starts that invasion (the Goblin Battle Standard). explosive spiky: a Spiky Ball (rolls, no blast, hurts `pierce` enemies).

accessories (and armor): wall_slide: Climbing Claws / Shoe Spikes (Terraria's spikedBoots, summed: 1 slides down walls, 2 sticks); lava_time: seconds of lava immunity (Lava Charm, Terraria's lavaMax); light_wet: its light under water (Jellyfish Necklace); cordage: vines drop Vine Rope; magiluminescence; wings: {time: flight ticks (wingTimeMax), lift_max: top climb in jump speeds}; diving: breath lasts 6x (Diving Helmet, accDivingHelm); info: an informational accessory that works anywhere in your inventory (watch: 1 hour, 2 half hour, 3 minute; depth; compass; radar).

magma_stone: melee hits set enemies on Hellfire (the Magma Stone: 6 s one hit in four, else 4 or 2). lava_rose: lava does 45 less damage and burns half as long (the Obsidian Rose). leech (melee): a swing heals you 1 (the Bat Bat).

grab_range: items come to you from that many blocks further (the Treasure Magnet: Terraria's 150 px at 24 a block). converts (ranged): {ammo: projectile} fires that instead (the Hellwing Bow's Wooden Arrows: Hellwings; Molten Fury's: Flaming Arrows). sickness: potion sickness this long instead of 60 s (the Restoration Potion: 45). swing_dust: [Terraria dust id, a tick, scale] thrown off along a swing (the Molten tools' and the Fiery Greatsword's fire). volcano (melee): the first enemy a swing hits erupts (the Fiery Greatsword: Terraria's Volcano, 75% of the hit's damage to up to 3 enemies within 80 px, each set On Fire! for 3 s).
yoyo (melee): {reach in blocks (Terraria's tiles), duration: seconds of spin, speed: Terraria's top speed in mph} (scripts/entities/yoyo.gd). yoyo_string (accessory): longer reach.

spear (melee): Terraria's spear projectile (AI 19): {speed: the item's shoot speed (Terraria px a tick), base, out, back: how far the tip goes, lunge: [L, S] the Dark Lance's / Rotted Fork's reach past the tip}; bolt: a projectile thrown as it goes (Storm Spear) (scripts/entities/spear.gd).

slash (melee): Terraria's held slashes (projectile AI 75: the Terragrim): {size: hitbox [w, h] in Terraria px, centred on you; frames of the projectile's sheet; speed: the item's shoot speed (px a tick: where its light and dust are, 3 ticks of it out); immunity: ticks before it can hit an enemy again; dust; light} (scripts/entities/slash.gd).

boomerang (melee): Terraria's boomerang projectile (AI 3): {speed: the item's shoot speed (px a tick), return: [speed, acceleration] coming back (default 9, 0.4), max: how many can be out (1), fall: ticks before it drops instead of turning round (Bloody Machete)} (scripts/entities/boomerang.gd). crit: the weapon's own crit chance bonus.

anim: an animated item (Terraria's item animations, Main.InitializeItemAnimations): {frames stacked down its sprite, ticks each, ping_pong}. dawn: lying in the world it fades at sunrise (Fallen Star); glow: it shines in the dark.
explosive (thrown items): {fuse s, radius blocks, tiles (destroys blocks), self (hurts you too; default true), sticky, contact (goes off on hitting an enemy), bounce} (Game.explode).
value: Terraria's price in copper coins (buy price; you sell for a fifth). Items without one are worth what their recipe's ingredients are (Data.value).

Recipes are Terraria's own (assets/terraria/recipes.json, from Terraria.exe by tools/terraria_recipes.py), for every item here whose ingredients and stations are here too. "recipes" below are stand-ins for items none of whose Terraria recipes can be made yet (stand_in says why); they drop out once one can.
Ingredient names may list alternatives: "IronBar|LeadBar". "Wood" means any wood (Data.ANY_WOOD), unless the recipe is "exact" (Terraria's Wooden Door takes plain Wood).
